ai.thread_title: Gemini model pricing creates cost/capability confusion in market
ai.name: Simon Willison
ai.hook: Simon Willison notes Gemini 4 Carbon, Argon, Hydrogen pricing is confusing and inconsistent.
insights: Gemini 4 Carbon: $2/M input, $10/M output at launch
Hydrogen (lowest cost tier) pricing **not far off** Carbon despite significant capability gap
**Pricing lacks clear signal** for which tier to use for different workloads
ai.for_you: Pedro needs clear cost/capability guidance to confidently recommend models to Portuguese SMB clients. Current Gemini pricing inconsistency creates confusion. Consider building a client-facing model recommendation tool that maps cost to capability and ROI.
ai.context: Google is consolidating Gemini 4 into multiple tiers (Carbon, Argon, Hydrogen), but pricing doesn't clearly differentiate capability levels. This creates buyer confusion when selecting which tier to use.
ai.what_changed: Gemini Hydrogen launch (low-cost tier) has exposed pricing inconsistency across tiers; market needs clarity.
ai.action: investigate / Need to understand Gemini pricing tiers clearly before recommending to clients. Consider building pricing comparison matrix for agency pitch materials.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Directly affects Pedro's client recommendations and margin calculation for model selection
